title: Mississippi State vs Texas A&M Prediction: Can the Aggies Sidestep the Landmine? - NewsBreak
text:
By Pete Fiutak ,
1 hours ago This was supposed to be the sleepwalk game.
Texas A&M is coming off dates with Notre Dame and Auburn. Florida is up next, followed by three straight road games. Mississippi State? The Aggies won the last two meetings by a combined score of 85 to 34.
And then a funny thing happened. Mississippi State got good.
The offense under head coach Jeff Lebby took things up a notch, the defense stepped up so far, and after a 4-0 start with a win over Arizona State, now there's a chance to do some damage.
Both teams miss Alabama, and the Bulldogs get Georgia and Texas in Starkville, but the Aggies have to go to LSU, Missouri, and Texas.
Mississippi State Bulldogs vs Texas A&M Aggies Preview Sep 27, 2025; College Station, Texas, USA; Texas A&M Aggies tight end Kiotti Armstrong (21) reacts during the second half against the Auburn Tigers at Kyle Field.© Maria Lysaker-Imagn Images

Why Mississippi State Will Win The offense is doing what it's supposed to.
Quarterback Blake Shapen is healthy, he knows the offense, and things are moving. It's not just about the passing game - that's been a bit hit-or-miss - but the balance is there.
The ground attack rocked over the last few weeks, the passing game was great when it needed to be against Arizona State, and all parts have to keep pushing.
As strong as Texas A&M has been over this 4-0 start, the third down conversions aren't there as often as they should be, and there aren't any takeaways with just three so far. However...
Sep 27, 2025; Starkville, Mississippi, USA; Mississippi State Bulldogs quarterback Blake Shapen (2) runs with the ball during overtime against the Tennessee Volunteers at Davis Wade Stadium at Scott Field. © Wesley Hale-Imagn Images
Why Texas A&M Will Win Mississippi State is a penalty machine.
It's been hit with ten flags or more in three of the first five games, and the two turnovers against Tennessee proved costly.
The Bulldogs will have to do everything right, and that includes keeping Shapen from getting popped.
The Texas A&M defensive front is fantastic at getting into the backfield, and on the flip side, quarterback Marcel Reed doesn't have to worry too much against an MSU defense that doesn't get into the backfield.
Tennessee's offense was able to move the ball a bit too easily in key moments in the overtime win over the Bulldogs, and ...
Texas A&M's O Will Go Again It was too much of a struggle to get by Auburn.
Texas A&M had a hard time on third downs. It was a struggle to put the game away, with the defense needing to come up big to hold things down late.
This will be a bit more of a shootout. The Aggies will get the running game going again. Teams haven't committed enough to the ground game - Airozna State ran 51 times, but no one hammered away in the three games since.
A&M will rely on the offensive front to take over early on, and it'll work late as it keeps the ball for at least 35 minutes.
Mississippi State vs Texas A&M Prediction, Betting Lines Texas A&M 34, Mississippi State 20
